title: Contrast Pack
description: TexturePack that increases the contrast of the game, both menus, panoramas and GamePlay.
body: Increase the contrast of textures, making them look deeper or more vibrant. Shadows appear sharper, lights brighter, giving the game a bold retro touch. Perfect for players who enjoy a clean, pixel look. With simple rendering tweaks and texture changes, it adds more depth and detail, sometimes even a shader‑like feel—without using shaders. ### 🎨 Features: - More vibrant and deeper colors. - Support for vanilla: mobs, blocks, entities, and more. - Vanilla standard (16x) lightweight, ideal for low‑spec PCs. - For players who enjoy using features like Optifine or Continuity: certain versions include compatibility with connected glass through the ConnectedBlocks function. --- ### ⛏ Utility: This pack works perfectly in both single-player worlds and vanilla servers. It doesn’t alter gameplay directly, so it won’t add or remove anything that changes your vanilla experience — only visual improvements. If you’d like to keep the vanilla essence but make it a little more vibrant and colorful, this might be the one to try! --- ## 🎬 See It in Action ![Happy Ghast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76e1a22b817309f477c860728b7a514153b882dd.png) ![Badlands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5357f82c9f8426d59ae57ec7a7ab3ab1f442e80.png) --- **✨ Compatible with Minecraft Java:** - 26.1.x [Latest] - 1.21.x - 1.20.x [📥 Download it now and rediscover Minecraft in a more colorful, vibrant way!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/contrastpack/versions) ---
